name: NetProbe
description: Comprehensive network test tool: ping, traceroute, port scan, TLS, DNS and a findings list per target.
long_description: Enter an IP address, DNS name, network (CIDR) or range. Single addresses go straight into the list, networks are scanned. For every target NetProbe runs a battery of tests you can switch on and off by category: ping with latency, jitter and TTL, parallel traceroute with per-hop analysis, TCP port scan with a library of 130+ services and typical usage scenarios, HTTP and TLS inspection, SMB/RDP/NTP checks and full DNS diagnostics for names (records, name servers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, DNSSEC). Each target opens its own dockable tab with results per category plus a Findings tab listing errors, warnings and best-practice notes. No admin rights required.
author: DarkMatter
